Reliza, sorry for keeping you waiting!
I've been expecting you...\nOh, who is that?
Huh? Oh, this thing?\nIt's a long story and we decided to take him\nalong...
Aye, I'm Anono. Nice to meet you!
W-well, we'll tell you the details once we find\nthe ark...Let's start searching for the ark too!
Ayyy!!
Hey, wait! That's a river!
Oh noo!!
Water, it's water!\nAye, I feel alive again!!
Eh? Whaat?! No way!\nIsn't it a Coenubia?!
I wonder if the Coenubia attached to Anono's body\nhas vanished or escaped from his body...
Aye? What is it?
Aye? I feel something...
Hey, wait, where are you going?
Oh my gosh!\nThere, over there!\nLook, there's something!!
That's the ark, isn't it?!\nL-l-let's go down and check it out, c'mon!
E-e-e-evil spirit!\nNo waaaaaay!!
Hmph!!\nI dislike their presence!!
Hey, you were being attacked by the evil spirits,\nare you okay? Are you injured?
Yes, I'm fine...!\nThis voice...I knew it would be yours, Reliza!
What...Arone, it's you!
The person being attacked by the evil spirits was\nArone who was protecting the Premiere Gem in the\nRuined Temple.
You're...the adventurer I met in the temple\nbefore, right? Long time no see!
I've heard many great stories about you from the\nResistle undercover agents and the peddlers.\nYou're an amazing person!
You seem to want to ask me something.\nPlease go ahead, I'll answer your questions...
What brings you here?
How did you know Reliza?
Is it ok to be away from the temple?
I have no questions for you.
Actually, the other day I found a note left by the\ntrainee monks that had gone missing. The note says\nthey're heading to Celarra.
So I came here. But then I sensed a disturbing\npresence around here and while I was trying to\nfind out what it was, the monsters attacked me...
Before going to the temple, I was learning magic\nin El Scaro.
Reliza is my friend. She was learning the same\nmagic and she was so good that she became King\nElbano's spy around that time...
Yes, there has been no human in the temple since\nyou left. You're worried that the Premiere Gem\nwill get stolen, aren't you?
Don't worry. Captain Cipiwon of the Resistle\nundercover agents is guarding it while I'm not\naround.
Otherwise I won't be able to travel all the way to\na place like this...
Hey, don't you think the missing trainee monks\nthat Arone mentioned are somewhat related to the\nark?
The fact that there are two totally different\nmysteries in the same place is just too good to be\na coincidence, right?
You won't get the answer even if you think deeply.\nArone's problem didn't seem to happen here, let's\ntry going to where the thing we're looking for is!
Alright, alright, that's enough of babbling.\nTime to resume the search for the ark.
Regarding Arone's problem, what if we help too\nafter finding the ark?
Okay. Let's prioritize and solve what's more\nimportant first. I'll go with you to find the ark.
EVENT BATTLE\nRepel the evil spirits!!
